text: Two types share one rule: the soft fresco is cut small and not cooked, ripened a few weeks; the semi-hard stagionato is cut finer, may be cooked a little, salted longer and ripened four months or more. Only whole sheep's milk of Tuscany and nearby areas may be used.

steps.note: Hazelnut size for fresco, maize-kernel size for stagionato.
Only the stagionato curd may be cooked.
Whey drained by hand pressing or in a steam-heated room.
Dry or in brine (15–17 °Bé), at least 8 h per kg for fresco, 12 h for stagionato.

microbes.name: native, natural or selected lactic cultures

steps.note: At least 20 days for the soft fresco or 4 months for the semi-hard stagionato.
